# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 3 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 10 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 1 token.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #f1eee8);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #f1eee8;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #f1eee8 | Page ground for every chapter. ink 16.1:1, ink-muted 5.2:1. |
| `--surface-raised` | #faf9f6 | Floating dock, inputs, phone screens, tooltips. One step above surface. ink 17.7:1, ink-muted 5.8:1. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #14130f);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #14130f;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #14130f | Headlines and body on surface and surface-raised, the solid fill of primary buttons, the phone bezel. |
| `--ink-muted` | #66625a | Secondary copy, mono labels and captions on surface and surface-raised only. Never on colour fills. |
| `--ink-soft` | #2a2823 | A lift on the ink ground: phone bezels and hairlines inside ink scenes. Decorative. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css

```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-ember` | #14130f | Text and marks on an ember fill: 5.7:1. The logo dot inverts to this colour on an ember ground. |
| `--on-ink` | #f1eee8 | Text on the ink ground in dark scenes (Craft, Contact): 16.1:1. |
| `--on-ink-muted` | #a8a399 | Secondary copy and labels on the ink ground: 7.4:1. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ember, #ff4f1f);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #ff4f1f;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ember` | #ff4f1f | The only accent in the whole site: the logo dot, cursor, scroll thread dot and the active word in the Index. Never a fill larger than a dot, except the Contact scene. One per viewport. As a graphic on bone it is 2.8:1, so it never carries meaning alone. For text use ember-text. |
| `--ember-text` | #c2370f | Ember as text on surface and surface-raised: 4.7:1 and 5.2:1. Use for the one italic accent word per headline (24px and up). |
| `--focus` | #14130f | Solid 2px keyboard focus ring with 3px offset. 16.1:1 on bone; use on-ink (16.1:1) on ink scenes. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 176px/160px "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -5px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -5px;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 176px / 160px, letter-spacing -5px | 600 | `display` | Hello and name moments only. Set at font-stretch 125%. Fit to width on the loader. |
| `display-l` | `.display-l`, `--text-display-l` | 104px / 96px, letter-spacing -3px | 600 | `display` | Scene headlines and counters. |
| `display-m` | `.display-m`, `--text-display-m` | 64px / 60px, letter-spacing -2px | 600 | `display` | Work card titles, big section numbers. |
| `accent-l` | `.accent-l`, `--text-accent-l` | 120px / 106px, italic, letter-spacing -3px | 400 | `accent` | The single ember word inside a display-l headline, in ember-text. |
| `accent-m` | `.accent-m`, `--text-accent-m` | 72px / 63px, italic, letter-spacing -2px | 400 | `accent` | The ember word inside a display-m headline. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 32px / 36px, letter-spacing -0.5px | 500 | `sans` | Beat headings and case-study subheads. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 17px / 26px | 400 | `sans` | Paragraphs. Max 60 characters per line. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Captions, dock links, buttons. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px, letter-spacing 1px | 500 | `mono` | Uppercase section numbers, tags, dates, live strip. 11px on mobile. |
| `mono-body` | `.mono-body`, `--text-mono-body` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | Contact details, stack lists. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |
| `accent` | `--font-accent` | `"Fraunces", "Times New Roman", serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Geist", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"Geist Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon gaps, label to value. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Dock padding, tag gaps. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Button vertical padding. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Page margin on mobile, card gutters. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Card padding. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Page margin on desktop, 12-column gutter. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Between a title and its content. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Between groups inside a scene. |
| `--space-24` | 96px | Scene padding at tablet. |
| `--space-40` | 160px | Scene padding on desktop. |
